item.title: Holyrood Backs Bill to Strengthen Pupils’ Rights on Religious Observance
item.description: MSPs have passed legislation clarifying pupils’ rights on withdrawal from religious observance in schools, strengthening alignment with the UN Convention on the Rights of the Child while maintaining parental involvement.The post Holyrood Backs Bill to Strengthen Pupils’ Rights on Religious Observance appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Expanded 24 Hour Mental Health Support Backed by New Investment
item.description: The Scottish Government has announced expanded 24 hour mental health support through NHS 24 and a new Crisis Framework for Children and Young People, backed by an estimated £1.5 billion investment.The post Expanded 24 Hour Mental Health Support Backed by New Investment appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Orkney’s Copland’s Road Housing Development Approved for Capital Programme
item.description: A proposed 25 home social housing development at Copland’s Road in Stromness has been approved for Orkney Islands Council’s Capital Programme as part of wider plans to increase affordable housing supply.The post Orkney’s Copland’s Road Housing Development Approved for Capital Programme appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Community Trust to Take Full Control of Strathpeffer Pavilion
item.description: Strathpeffer Pavilion Community Trust will take full control of the historic venue from High Life Highland on 31 March 2026, marking a new community led era for the popular Ross shire events space.The post Community Trust to Take Full Control of Strathpeffer Pavilion appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Minister Visits UHI Optometry Programme In Inverness
item.description: Public Health Minister Jenni Minto visited UHI Inverness to tour its optometry programme, highlighting the new Masters of Optometry with Independent Prescribing and its role in supporting rural eyecare in Scotland.The post Minister Visits UHI Optometry Programme In Inverness appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Free Prescriptions Save Highland Households Around £450 a Year
item.description: New figures show households in NHS Highland received more than seven million free prescriptions last year, with average savings of around £440 per household compared to charges in England.The post Free Prescriptions Save Highland Households Around £450 a Year appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Campaign Urges Inverness Shoppers to Check Blood Pressure and Protect Their Hearts
item.description: Around 40,500 people in Inverness are believed to be living with undiagnosed high blood pressure. A free 10 minute check at Tesco Inverness Inshes Extra during Heart Month could help prevent heart attacks and strokes.The post Campaign Urges Inverness Shoppers to Check Blood Pressure and Protect Their Hearts appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: 25 Million Across UK Living Below Minimum Income Standard, Report Finds
item.description: A new report reveals 25 million people across the UK are living below the Minimum Income Standard, including more than half of all children. The findings have sparked renewed political debate over living standards and the cost of living crisis.The post 25 Million Across UK Living Below Minimum Income Standard, Report Finds appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Former SNP MSP to Stand for Alba on Highlands and Islands List
item.description: Former SNP MSP Mike MacKenzie will stand for ALBA on the Highlands and Islands list in May’s Holyrood election, joining Angus Brendan MacNeil and other candidates in a bid to win regional representation.The post Former SNP MSP to Stand for Alba on Highlands and Islands List appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: A Contemporary Lodge Set Above Loch Ness
item.description: Set within the Loch Ness Highland Resort on Glendoe Road, this contemporary two bedroom lodge with wrap around decking and hot tub offers year round leisure use and sub letting potential in one of Scotland’s most iconic landscapes.The post A Contemporary Lodge Set Above Loch Ness appeared first on The Highland Times.
